reviewNote: FLUX generally follows the original cast and composition more closely. SDXL Turbo still changes identities or adds people; these are style auditions, not accepted production frames.

methods.flux: 4-step reference-guided edit of the exact master of the attached screenshot, CFG1, reference strength0.65.
methods.sdxl: Same source master, image-to-image, four actual Euler ancestral denoising steps, eight-step trailing schedule at strength0.5, CFG1/conditional only. Compact prompt for the same style.
